text.p: Finnish engineering group Oy Tampella Ab said in a statement on Thursday it expected a profit in September-December, but a smaller one than in the beginning of the year.

"The positive accumulation of earnings is expected to grow further, although it is unlikely to reach in the last four months quite the level of the beginning of the year," Tampella said in its January-August interim report.
In January-August, Tampella's profit before extraordinary items was 109 million markka. In January-April, the profit was 68 million markka.

Tampella said full-year net sales of its biggest division, mining equipment maker Tamrock, would increase clearly. In 1995, Tamrock's net sales were 2.97 billion markka. In January-August, the division's net sales were 2.27 billion markka, up 19.5 percent on the year-ago period.

Tamrock's 1996 earnings would improve slightly on last year, Tampella said. In 1995, Tamrock's operating profit was 179 million markka. In January-August, its operating profit rose to 143 million markka from 132 million.
